title: Finland – Diagnostic devices – Diffuusiokapasiteetti/Spirometrialaitteistot
description: Hankinnan kohteena on Etelä-Savon hyvinvointialueen (Eloisa) Mikkelin keskussairaalaan tuleva diffuusiokapasiteetti-/spirometrialaitteisto (1 kpl) sekä laitekohtaiset kulutustarvikkeet, ohjelmisto, lisenssit ja huoltopalvelu. Hankinnassa on lisäksi optio kahdelle (2) vastaavanlaiselle laitekokonaisuudelle (diffuusiokapasiteetti-/spirometrialaitteistot) sekä yhdelle (1) spirometrialaitteistolle. Eloisa päättää mahdollisten optioiden hankkimisesta vuoden 2028 loppuun mennessä. Sopimuskausi alkaa sopimuksen allekirjoittamisesta. Sopimus allekirjoitetaan mahdollisimman pian lainvoimaisen päätöksen jälkeen. Sopimus on toistaiseksi voimassa oleva. Laitteen tulee soveltua diffuusiokapasiteetin mittaamiseen ja spirometriatutkimusten tekemiseen. Spirometria ja diffuusiokapasiteetti ovat keskeisiä keuhkojen toimintakokeita. Spirometrialla mitataan keuhkojen tilavuutta ja ilman virtausta, mikä auttaa tunnistamaan ahtauttavat (esim. astma, COPD) tai rajoittavat keuhkosairaudet. Diffuusiokapasiteetti mittaa kaasujen siirtymistä keuhkorakkuloista vereen, ja sitä käytetään keuhkokudoksen sairauksien (esim. fibroosi) arvioinnissa. Laitteella tulee pystyä tekemään spirometria ja bronkodilataatiokoe, diffuusiokoe hengityslihasvoiman mittaus sekä SNIP. Pyydettäessä tarjoaja toimittaa kustannuksellaan tarjotun laitteistokokonaisuuden koekäyttöön Mikkelin keskussairaalalle. Tarjouspyyntö julkaistaan ehdollisena optioiden osalta: optioiden hankinnat voidaan toteuttaa, mikäli hankinnoille varatut investointimäärärahat hyväksytään.

title: Finland – Software package and information systems – VMware-ohjelmistolisenssien hankinta
description: Fintraffic Tie Oy on aiemmin 21.4.2026 julkaistavaksi lähetetyllä ilmoituksella kilpailuttanut VMware-ohjelmistolisenssien hankinnan. Kilpailutuksen jälkeen on ilmennyt seikkoja, jotka edellyttävät hankinnan kilpailuttamista uudelleen. Tällä ilmoituksella kilpailutetaan uudelleen VMware-ohjelmistolisenssien hankinta. Hankinnan kohteena ovat Fintraffic Tie Oy:n (jäljempänä myös "Hankintayksikkö" ja "Tilaaja") nykyisen tienvarsiteknologian kapasiteettialustapalvelun päällä ajettavan palvelinvirtualisaatiojärjestelmän tarvitsemat VMware-lisenssit. Virtualisaatiojärjestelmä hankitaan liikenteenhallinnan työkuormien virtualisoituun ajoon. Lisenssejä käytetään Hankintayksikön itse hallinnoimassa ympäristössä Hankintayksikön omissa konesaleissa. Hankinnan tarve johtuu siitä, että Hankintayksikön koko palvelinvirtualisoinnit perustuvat VMwaren tekniikkaan. Tilaajan palvelimista on virtualisoitu noin 95 %. Hankintayksikön nykyinen lisensiointi VMware Cloud Foundationista (VCF) on päättynyt 02/2026 hankintakanavan umpeutuessa. Hankinnan ehtona on, että Hankintayksikkö hallitsee VMware-ympäristönsä itse omista konesaleistaan käsin. Hankintayksiköllä tulee olla myös mahdollisuus avata tukipyyntöjä suoraan Broadcomille sekä käyttää Broadcomin tarjoamia teknisiä verkkokursseja ja koulutusmateriaaleja asiantuntijoidensa osaamisen ylläpitämiseksi. Hankinnan tavoitteena on hankkia kumppani lisenssien välittämiseen. Tilattavien lisenssien coremäärät on ilmoitettu liitteessä 3 Hintalomake. Hankinnan kohde ja niiden vähimmäisvaatimukset on kuvattu tarkemmin tarjouspyynnön liitteissä. Hankintayksikkö valitsee kilpailutuksen perusteella kokonaistaloudellisesti edullisimman tarjouksen tehneen tarjoajan, jolta tilaukset tehdään. Kokonaistaloudellisesti edullisimpana pidetään tarjousta, joka on vertailuhinnaltaan halvin. Vertailuhinnan muodostuminen on kuvattu tarkemmin jäljempänä tarjouspyynnössä liitteineen. Sopimuskausi on määräaikainen kolmen (3) tai viiden (5) vuoden ajan, jonka jälkeen se jatkuu toistaiseksi voimassa olevana. Sopimuksen enimmäisarvo on 4.000.000 euroa. Määräaikaisen sopimuskauden kesto määräytyy sen mukaan, minkä lisenssipaketin Hankintayksikkö päättää valita. Ks. tarkemmin tarjouspyynnön osio "Muut tiedot - Päätöksenteon perusteet". Hankintaan sisältyy lisähankintamahdollisuutena Hankintayksikön oikeus hankkia tarpeen vaatiessa lisää lisenssipaketeissa mainittuja lisenssejä sekä muita Broadcomin tuotteisiin liittyviä lisenssejä sopimuskauden aikana ns. päivän hinnalla. Hankintayksikkö ei sitoudu mihinkään hankintamääriin. Hankintayksiköllä on oikeus muuttaa hankittavien lisenssien määrää sopimuskauden aikana.

title: Evaluation of Rural Land Market Reporting
description: The aims of the project are to produce an evaluation of the SLCâs rural land market reporting to generate insights and improvements for future reporting. The evaluation will focus on several elements: 1) Impact â this objective is to understand the use of the report and its effects, outcomes and the extent to which reporting is effective in informing policy and decision making. There is a comparative element for this. 2) Process â understanding the effectiveness of the current approach, how the reporting process is working, assessing potential improvements to the methodology, and considering expansion of the coverage of reporting to other areas. 3) Economic Value â understanding value for money and costing the tangible benefits of the reports compared to the costs. What are the wider economic benefits to participants, public finances and society? 4) Analysis and Recommendations â the above steps inform the analysis and evaluation to understand to what extent and degree of progress towards the reporting aims are being made, and any recommendations for improvements. The report should, where appropriate, include advice for the SLC for future land market reports.

title: Design-Build of a Tier II Mobile Command Post Vehicle (MCPV) Trailer
description: Amendment 0001 The purpose for Amendment 0001 is to change the time offers are due from 2 p.m. Eastern Time (ET) to 8 a.m. ET. The due date remains unchanged. The Federal Bureau of Investigation (FBI) intends to award a single-award, Firm-Fixed-Price, Indefinite-Delivery/Indefinite-Quantity (IDIQ) contract for Tier II Mobile Command Post Vehicle (MCPV) systems. The purpose of this acquisition is to establish a contract vehicle for the design, engineering, manufacturing, integration, testing, and production of trailer-based mobile command post systems capable of supporting FBI command, control, communications, and computer (C4) operations. The Tier II MCPV requirement consists of a custom-integrated gooseneck trailer system and, when ordered, a compatible Class 4 prime hauler vehicle. The MCPV Trailer shall provide a mobile operational environment supporting mission communications, networking, workspace, power generation and distribution, environmental control, equipment racks, audio/visual capabilities, RF and satellite connectivity provisions, security systems, and integration of Government-furnished and Contractor-furnished mission equipment. The contract will include a First Article requirement. The Contractor shall design, manufacture, integrate, test, and obtain Government approval of an initial MCPV Trailer configuration prior to production quantities. The approved First Article configuration will establish the production baseline for subsequent MCPV Trailer systems. The Government anticipates ordering approximately thirteen (13) MCPV trailer systems and associated prime hauler vehicles over the contract ordering period; however, the Government guarantees only the minimum contract obligation identified in the solicitation. The maximum contract value shall not exceed $15,000,000.00.

title: Sääsuojaratkaisu rakennustyömaalle
description: Sääsuojaratkaisu rakennustyömaalle Raision seudun koulutuskuntayhtymä pyytää tarjouksia Rasekon ammattiopiston rakennustyömaille hankittavasta uudesta ja käyttämättömästä rakennuksen sääsuojaratkaisusta. Hankinnan kohteena on talon rakentamisvaiheessa käytettävä sääsuojaratkaisu, jonka avulla turvataan työskentelyolosuhteet, rakenteiden kuivana pysyminen sekä rakennusprosessin laatu vaihtelevissa sääolosuhteissa. Sääsuojaratkaisua käytetään oppilaitoksen opetustyömailla, joissa rakennusalan opiskelijat toteuttavat pientalorakentamista osana koulutustaan. Ratkaisun tulee soveltua opetuskäyttöön sekä olla turvallinen ja helppokäyttöinen. Hankittavan sääsuojaratkaisun tulee: - Soveltua liitteessä 3 esitetyn rakennuksen suojaamiseen. - Olla yhteensopiva olemassa olevien Layher-telineiden kanssa. - Sisältää rakennuksen pitkille sivuille tulevat osat (poislukien ulkoneva katos) sekä kattorakenteen. Sääsuojaratkaisun päädyt toteutetaan Rasekon ammattiopiston olemassa olevilla Layher-telineosilla. Tarjottavan sääsuojaratkaisun tulee soveltua pientalokohteiden eri rakentamisvaiheisiin (runko-, julkisivu- ja vesikattovaihe) sekä kestää tavanomaiset suomalaiset sääolosuhteet, kuten tuuli-, sade- ja lumikuormat. Toimitus: Hankinnan kohteena oleva sääsuojaratkaisu tulee toimittaa viimeistään 15.12.2026. Toimituksen tulee sisältää kaikki hankinnan kohteeseen kuuluvat osat siten, että sääsuojaratkaisu on käyttöönotettavissa toimituksen jälkeen ilman olennaisia lisähankintoja. Hankinnan tavoitteena on parantaa työturvallisuutta, rakentamisen laatua sekä opetuksen sujuvuutta. Hankinnan kohde kuvataan tarkemmin tässä tarjouspyynnössä liitteineen. title: Kotiin annettavat turvalaitteet, hälytysten vastaanottopalvelu ja hälytysten vastaanottojärjestelmä
description: Kotiin annettavat turvalaitteet, hälytysten vastaanottopalvelu ja hälytysten vastaanottojärjestelmä Lapin hyvinvointialue pyytää tarjouksia kokonaisuudesta, johon sisältyvät: 1. kotiin annettavat turvalaitteet Lapin hyvinvointialueen asiakkaille 2. hälytysten vastaanottopalvelu 3. hälytysten vastaanottojärjestelmä edellä mainitun palvelun tuottamiseen hyvinvointialueen omana toimintana. Hankinnassa turvalaitteilla tarkoitetaan erilaisia kotiin annettavia turvalaitteita, joilla voidaan parantaa kotona asuvan asiakkaan turvallisuutta. Hankittavia turvalaitteita ovat turvapuhelimet ja niiden lisälaitteet, paikantava turvaranneke sekä ratkaisu yhteisöllisen asumisen ovivalvontaan. Hälytysten vastaanottopalvelulla tarkoitetaan palvelua, jossa otetaan vastaan turvalaitteiden kautta tulevat hälytykset, tehdään alustavan arvion avuntarpeesta ja välitetään pyyntö edelleen turva-auttajille. Palvelun tulee toiminnassa vuorokauden ympäri vuoden jokaisena päivä. Hälytysten vastaanottojärjestelmällä tarkoitetaan järjestelmää, jolla tilaaja voi ottaa eri turvalaitteiden hälytykset vastaan ja edelleenvälittää ne tehtävänä turva-auttajille. Lapin hyvinvointialueella on tarkoitus ottaa hälytysten vastaanottopalvelu omaksi toiminnaksi alustavan aikataulun mukaan keväällä 2028. Hyvinvointialue hankkii hälytysten vastaanottopalvelua siihen asti, kunnes vastaanottojärjestelmä on otettu käyttöön, minkä jälkeen vastaanottopalvelun hankinta päättyy. Hankinnan kohde on kuvattu tarkemmin tarjouspyynnössä ja sen liitteissä, erityisesti liitteessä 1 "Hankinnan kohteen kuvaus". Kilpailutuksessa valitaan yksi toimitta puitesopimustoimittajaksi. Puitejärjestelyn kautta hyvinvointialue hankkii valitulta toimittajalta turvalaitteita ja palveluita sopimuskauden aikana tarpeen mukaan. Hyvinvointialueen tarpeet voivat vaihdella sopimuskauden aikana, eikä tarjouspyynnöllä sitouduta tiettyihin hankintamääriin. Puitesopimuksen sopimuskausi on määräaikaisena kaksi vuotta, jonka jälkeen sopimus jatkuu toistaiseksi voimassa olevana. Hankintayksikön tarkoitus on tehdä sopimus valitun toimittajan kanssa heti, kun tarjousaika on päättynyt, tarjoukset on vertailtu, hankintapäätös on tehty ja muutoksenhakuaika on päättynyt. Hankintayksikön arvion mukaan ajankohta on lokakuun 2026 aikana. Laitevaihtojen toteutuksen ja muiden käyttöönottoon liittyvien toimien aikataulut sovitaan yhdessä valitun toimittajan kanssa molempien osapuolten tarpeet huomioivalla tavalla. Lisäksi valitulta toimittajalta hankitaan hälytysten vastaanottojärjestelmä kokonaisuutena, johon sisältyy järjestelmän toimittaminen ja sen jatkuva palvelu. Järjestelmän jatkuvan palvelun sopimus on voimassa toistaiseksi. Hankintaa ei ole jaettu osiin, koska kyseessä on yhtenäinen tavaroiden ja palveluiden muodostama kokonaisuus, jonka kaikkien osasten yhteensopivuus on voitava varmistaa. Lapin hyvinvointialueen asiakkaiden turvallisuuden kannalta on tärkeää, että yksi toimittaja vastaa koko kokonaisuuden toimivuudesta. title: Memorialinio kūrinio Klaipėdos miesto įkūrėjams įamžinti sukūrimo ir pastatymo projekto konkursas. (ATVIRAS PROJEKTO KONKURSAS)
description: Memorialinio kūrinio Klaipėdos miesto įkūrėjams įamžinti sukūrimo ir pastatymo projektas. Projekto konkurso dalyviai turi pateikti memorialinio kūrinio meninę idėją, atspindinčią Klaipėdos miesto įkūrimo istoriją, miesto tapatybę ir istorinę atmintį. Projektas turi apimti memorialinio kūrinio meninius, architektūrinius ir techninius sprendinius, jo integravimą į pasirinktą vietą. Kartu turi būti pateikti memorialinio kūrinio vizualiniai, konstrukciniai, medžiagiškumo ir apšvietimo sprendiniai. Su projekto konkurso laimėtoju numatoma sudaryti paslaugų pirkimo–pardavimo sutartį (toliau – projekto (paslaugų pirkimo–pardavimo) sutartis) dėl memorialinio kūrinio projektavimo, pagaminimo, pastatymo ir kitų su projekto įgyvendinimu susijusių darbų atlikimo. Išsamus projekto konkurso objekto aprašymas ir memorialiniam kūriniui keliami reikalavimai pateikiami Techninėje specifikacijoje (konkurso sąlygų 4 priedas). Projekto konkurso tikslas – atrinkti meniškai vertingiausią, istoriškai pagrįstą ir urbanistiniame kontekste tinkamiausią memorialinio kūrinio idėją, skirtą Klaipėdos miesto įkūrėjų atminimui įamžinti ir Klaipėdos miesto istorinės atminties puoselėjimui. Biudžetas: Perkančioji organizacija informuoja, kad memorialinio kūrinio projektavimo, pagaminimo, transportavimo, montavimo bei kitų su projekto įgyvendinimu susijusių paslaugų bendra kaina negali viršyti šiam projekto konkursui skirtos maksimalios sumos – t. y. 123 966,94 Eur be PVM (jei tiekėjas yra ne PVM mokėtojas ar paslaugos neapmokestinamos PVM, ar dėl kitų priežasčių Perkančiosios organizacijos galutinė tiekėjui mokėtina suma bus be PVM) arba 150 000,00 Eur su PVM. Svarbu: jeigu dalyvio pasiūlyta kaina bus didesnė nei šiame punkte nustatyta maksimali kaina, projektas bus atmestas kaip neatitinkantis konkurso dokumentų reikalavimų pagal projekto konkurso sąlygų 64.3 p. Projekto konkurso pirmąsias 3 vietas užėmusius dalyvius numatyta apdovanoti piniginiais prizais (premijomis). Perkančioji organizacija laimėjusiu nustato tik 1 (vieną) dalyvį, surinkusį daugiausiai balų ir esantį pirmoje vietoje, neatitikusį pašalinimo pagrindų ir atitikusį nustatytus kvalifikacijos reikalavimus.

title: NYOX 3T Upgrade Plus
description: NON-COMPETITIVE COMBINED SYNOPSIS / SOLICITATION Title: NYOX 3T Upgrade Plus Solicitation No.: 75N98026Q01218 This is a combined synopsis/solicitation for commercial products or commercial services prepared in accordance with the format in FAR Subpart 12.6, as supplemented with additional information included in this notice. This announcement constitutes the only solicitation; proposals are being requested, and a separate written solicitation will not be issued. The solicitation number is 75N98026Q01218. This solicitation is issued as a Notice of Intent (NOI) for a non-competitive acquisition and is intended to result in the award of a purchase order without providing for full and open competition. This acquisition is conducted under the authority of FAR 12.603, Streamlined Solicitation for Commercial Products or Commercial Services, and is not expected to exceed the Simplified Acquisition Threshold. The additional statutory and regulatory authority for this non-competitive acquisition is 41 U.S.C. 1901 and FAR 6.302-3(a)(2)(ii). The National Institutes of Health (NIH), Office of the Director, Office of Acquisitions, intends to negotiate and award a Firm-Fixed-Price Purchase Order on a non-competitive basis to: Canon Medical Components 2355 Main Street, Suite 150 Irvine, CA 92614 for the NYOX 3T Upgrade Plus, including associated hardware, software updates, service, maintenance, and warranty support. DESCRIPTION OF REQUIREMENT The NIH laboratory currently possesses an existing specialized MRI field camera used in conjunction with its clinical Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI) system. The field camera is an integral component of the existing research system and is used to monitor and improve the quality and reproducibility of MRI data. NIH requires an upgrade to the existing field camera system through the acquisition of the NYOX 3T Upgrade Plus, including a new hardware module and associated software, updates, service, maintenance, and warranty support for a period of three years. The procurement is necessary to maintain the functionality, compatibility, accuracy, and reliability of the existing MRI field-camera system and to ensure that NIH clinical MRI data remain accurate, consistent, and reproducible. Reproducibility is a critical consideration in biomedical research because reliable and repeatable measurements are necessary to support valid scientific conclusions. The existing field camera is a proprietary Canon product, and the required upgrade, associated hardware, software updates, and maintenance services must be fully compatible with the existing Canon system. The required upgrade components and related maintenance are available only from Canon Medical Components or an authorized source capable of providing Canon's proprietary equipment, software, updates, and service. Use of an alternative manufacturer's equipment or third-party components could result in incompatibility with the existing field camera system, loss of functionality, inability to obtain required proprietary software updates and service, and potential degradation of MRI data quality and reproducibility. Accordingly, the Government has determined that the required upgrade and associated services can only be obtained from the specified source. CONTRACT TYPE The Government intends to issue a Firm-Fixed-Price Purchase Order. LINE ITEM / PRODUCT REQUIREMENTS CLIN 0001 � 1 Each � NYOX 3T Upgrade Plus, including one adapter and three years of updates and service, consisting of: SVX002A � NYOX Hardware Service � 3 years SVX004A � skope-fx Field Explorer NYOX Updates � 3 years SVX005A � skope-sdk Software Development Kit NYOX Updates � 3 years SDK00XA � skope-sdk Software Development Kit NYOX, 5 seats, 1-year updates SFX000N � skope-fx Field Explorer NYOX, 5 seats, 1-year updates NYB128A � NYOX Base, 3T, 127.8 MHz Philips/GE NYC000A � NYOX Controller 1 Adapter CLIN 0002 � 1 Each � Tariff Charge The offeror shall provide pricing for all required items, including any applicable tariff charges, shipping, handling, installation, and other associated costs. APPLICABLE PROVISIONS AND CLAUSES The solicitation document and incorporated provisions and clauses are those in effect through Federal Acquisition Circular 2026-01, dated March 13, 2026. The associated NAICS code is 334510, and the applicable small business size standard is 1,250 employees. This requirement is not set aside for small business. The provision at FAR 52.212-1, Instructions to Offerors�Commercial Products and Commercial Services, applies to this acquisition. The provision at FAR 52.212-2, Evaluation�Commercial Products and Commercial Services, applies to this acquisition. The Government will evaluate quotations based on technical acceptability, price, delivery, and the offeror's ability to provide the required proprietary equipment, software, updates, maintenance, and warranty support. A written notice of award or acceptance of an offer, issued to the successful offeror within the time specified in the offer, shall result in a binding contract without further action by either party. The Government reserves the right to accept an offer before the expiration date specified in the offer, whether or not discussions are conducted, unless a written notice of withdrawal is received prior to award. Offerors shall include a completed copy of FAR 52.212-3, Offeror Representations and Certifications�Commercial Products and Commercial Services, with their offer. FAR 52.212-4, Contract Terms and Conditions�Commercial Products and Commercial Services, applies to this acquisition. FAR 52.212-5, Contract Terms and Conditions Required to Implement Statutes or Executive Orders�Commercial Products and Commercial Services, applies to this acquisition. The Defense Priorities and Allocations System (DPAS) is not applicable to this requirement. SUBMISSION REQUIREMENTS Responses shall include sufficient information to demonstrate the respondent's capability to provide the required products and services. Price quotations shall include, at a minimum: Unit price; List price, if applicable; Shipping and handling costs; Delivery timeframe after award; Delivery terms; Prompt payment discount terms; F.O.B. point (destination or origin); Product, model, catalog, and/or part numbers; Product descriptions; Warranty and maintenance information; and Any other information relevant to the Government's evaluation. Because this requirement involves proprietary equipment and compatibility with an existing Canon system, respondents shall also provide documentation establishing that the offered products and services are supplied by Canon Medical Components or an authorized Canon source and are compatible with the NIH laboratory's existing NYOX field-camera system. Responses shall include, as applicable: (a) Product, catalog, model, and/or part number(s); (b) Product description; (c) Documentation demonstrating that the offered items meet the Government's required specifications and compatibility requirements; (d) Quantity; (e) Estimated price or cost; (f) Shipping, handling, and/or installation charges; (g) Delivery timeframe after receipt of order; (h) Warranty and maintenance terms; and (i) Documentation of authorization to provide the specified Canon proprietary products and services, if the respondent is not the manufacturer. Responses must also include the offeror's Unique Entity Identifier (UEI), Taxpayer Identification Number (TIN), and business size certification. All offerors must be actively registered in the System for Award Management (SAM) at SAM.gov at the time of quotation submission and award. RESPONSE DEADLINE All responses must be received no later than September 21, 2026, at 9:00 a.m. Eastern Time and must reference Solicitation No. 75N98026Q01218. Responses shall be submitted electronically to: patricia.haun@nih.gov The Government intends to evaluate all information received in response to this notice and may make award based on the initial quo

title: Legal and Strategic Advisory Services Refresh / On-Ramping #01
description: 09/15/2026 - Update #0001 - Attachment E, Solicitation Questions, has been replaced with Attachment E, Solicitation Questions and Answers (Q&A). Please find attached the updated Attachment E as a result of the Q&A period. No substantive changes or amendments to the solicitation have been made as a result of this Update. 09/09/2026 - Original Description: This is a combined synopsis/solicitation and request for proposals (RFP) for commercial products or commercial services in accordance with the procedures of Federal Acquisition Regulation (FAR) part 12 - Acquisition of Commercial Products and Commercial Services and FAR part 15 - Contracting by Negotiation. Specifically, the Federal Housing Finance Agency (FHFA) is issuing this RFP in accordance with Attachment A, Performance Work Statement (PWS), Section 25, �On-Ramping and Refresh of [Indefinite-Delivery, Indefinite-Quantity] IDIQ Holders,� which states, �the Government retains the unilateral right, at any time during the ordering period of this IDIQ contract, to issue additional solicitations and award new IDIQ contracts for the same or substantially similar scope of work to refresh, expand, or otherwise ensure an adequate pool of qualified contractors.� FHFA issued previous RFP FHF-26-R-0032 for �Legal and Strategic Advisory Services,� which resulted in award of six (6) multiple-award IDIQ contracts: 95314326D0002 (ARNOLD & PORTER KAYE SCHOLER LLP) 95314326D0003 (BAKER & HOSTETLER LLP) 95314326D0004 (COHEN SEGLIAS PALLAS GREENHALL & FURMAN PC) 95314326D0005 (DUANE MORRIS LLP) 95314326D0006 (MAYNARD NEXSEN P.C) 95314326D0007 (MINTZ, LEVIN, COHN, FERRIS, GLOVSKY AND POPEO, P.C.) As a result of this Refresh / On-Ramping RFP, FHFA anticipates awarding multiple (likely no more than three (3)) IDIQ contract(s) with an ordering period from effective date of award to 07/26/2031, with the ability for task order performance to extend beyond that date in accordance with applicable terms and procedures. FHFA reserves the unilateral right to award no new IDIQ contracts under this Refresh / On-Ramping RFP. In the event FHFA awards IDIQ contracts as a result of this Refresh / On-Ramping RFP, the IDIQ contracts awarded will be incorporated into the existing multiple-award IDIQ contract vehicle and be eligible to compete for task orders as of the effective date of the award. This announcement constitutes the only solicitation with offers requested. FHFA has a requirement for law firms to provide legal and strategic advisory services to FHFA, which may include but are not limited to: litigation at the state and federal level; oversight and coordination of legal strategy; advice on policy decision making; regulatory advice with respect to the Regulated Entities, the Office of Finance, and U.S. FinTech LLC; significant experience with the Housing and Economic Recovery Act of 2008; legal advice in the areas of banking law, securities law, financial services regulation law; significant experience with the requirements of the Dodd-Frank Wall Street Reform and Consumer Protection Act, bankruptcy law, real estate law, antitrust law, administrative law, corporate law (including matters involving boards of directors and governance), insurance law, conservatorships and receiverships of financial institutions, insolvency law, artificial intelligence, privacy law (including but not limited to Privacy Act and Freedom of Information Act matters), internal operations, and other areas of law as needed. A significant portion of the work under these contracts is anticipated to be litigation related, both at the trial court and appellate levels. Litigation services may include, but are not limited to, investigations relating to fraud or other matters; multifamily and single-family real estate matters such as foreclosures, receiverships, or lien priority; federal, state, and local actions that may involve fines, fees, or penalties; issues that may arise related to the conservatorships of Fannie Mae or Freddie Mac; and other litigation or legal advice concerning matters related to the Regulated Entities, the Office of Finance, and U.S. FinTech, LLC. For litigation services, the Contractor shall also provide, as directed by FHFA, court reporting, videography, electronic discovery, exhibit preparation, and expert consultants/witnesses, and any other litigation related services as needed, including administrative and operational support services to support the representation of FHFA. In addition to litigation related issues, contractors are sought for non-litigation areas of legal practice to provide legal advice, analysis, and fact-finding, if appropriate, that are related to the areas of expertise described above. Please refer to Attachment A, PWS, for additional information. Questions or other suggested changes must be submitted via email to Steven Novotny, FHFA Contracting Officer, at Steven.Novotny@fhfa.gov by 9:00 a.m. Eastern on September 15, 2026. Offerors must use Attachment E to organize and submit their questions. The Phase I submission is due no later than the date and time identified on the Contract Opportunities webpage. Please refer to the attachments for additional information.

description: Title: Dynamic Light Scattering Instrument Upgrade Solicitation No.: 75N98026Q01220 This is a combined synopsis/solicitation for commercial products or commercial services prepared in accordance with the format in FAR Subpart 12.6, as supplemented with additional information included in this notice. This announcement constitutes the only solicitation; quotations are being requested, and a separate written solicitation will not be issued. The solicitation number is 75N98026Q01220. This solicitation is issued as a Notice of Intent (NOI) for a non-competitive acquisition and is intended to result in the award of a purchase order without providing for full and open competition. This acquisition is conducted under the authority of FAR 12.603, Streamlined Solicitation for Commercial Products or Commercial Services. The statutory authority for this non-competitive acquisition is 41 U.S.C. 1901, as implemented by FAR 6.302-3(a)(2)(ii), as applicable. The National Institutes of Health (NIH), Office of the Director, Office of Acquisitions, intends to negotiate and award a Firm-Fixed-Price Purchase Order on a non-competitive basis to: Waters Technologies Corporation 34 Maple Street Milford, MA 01757 for a Wyatt Systems DynaPro NanoStar II and associated upgrade/configuration, accessories, standards, installation, training, and technical support. DESCRIPTION OF REQUIREMENT The purpose of this acquisition is to replace an aging and failing dynamic light scattering (DLS) instrument currently used by the NIH laboratory. The existing Wyatt DLS instrument is approximately 16 years old and is well beyond its expected service life. In addition, degradation of the instrument's laser has significantly reduced its performance and rendered it unsuitable for many protein samples. The Government requires a replacement system that provides reliable, high-sensitivity dynamic light scattering measurements while maintaining compatibility with the laboratory's existing Wyatt Systems infrastructure, workflows, and applications. The proposed Wyatt Systems DynaPro NanoStar II provides combined Dynamic Light Scattering (DLS) and Static Light Scattering (SLS) capabilities. These complementary measurements provide information regarding particle size and molecular mass and will support characterization of protein complexes and higher-order assemblies relevant to ongoing NIH research involving viral nucleocapsid proteins and other biomolecular systems. The system's broad measurement range, wide temperature range, small-volume sample capability, and rapid, non-destructive measurements are particularly important for research involving limited quantities of protein or samples that are difficult to produce. The ability to perform measurements using small sample volumes will help conserve valuable research materials and facilitate routine sample characterization. The replacement instrument will also support collaborative research projects by providing an accessible and standardized method for screening sample quality before more resource-intensive analyses are undertaken. This capability is expected to improve laboratory efficiency, maximize the use of shared research resources, and enhance the reliability and reproducibility of experimental results. Failure to replace the existing instrument would adversely affect mission-critical research activities that rely on DLS characterization and could result in delays to ongoing studies and cascading impacts on collaborating laboratories that depend on access to this capability. The Government requires the complete system configuration, associated standards and consumables, installation, certification, training, and applicable technical support identified below. title: Specialized Research Support Services
description: The National Institutes of Health (NIH) intends to award a Firm-Fixed-Price Purchase Order to KEMRI-Wellcome Trust Research Programme for Specialized Research Support Services in support of the Kwashiorkor Collaboration Network ("KwashNet"). The Government intends to solicit from a single source in accordance with Federal Acquisition Regulation (FAR) 6.302-1, Only One Responsible Source and No Other Supplies or Services Will Satisfy Agency Requirements. The Government anticipates awarding a firm-fixed-price purchase order for specialized research support services, including participant data collection and management, biological sample processing, DNA extraction and quantification, sample shipment to NIH, and scientific consultation in support of an international genomic study of severe acute malnutrition (SAM). The Contractor shall provide personnel with the specialized qualifications and experience necessary to perform the required work. The anticipated level of effort includes: Study Coordinator � 10% Effort The Study Coordinator shall directly manage participant data and biological sample collection activities, including data quality assurance and coordination of study activities. Laboratory Technician � 100% Effort The Laboratory Technician shall perform DNA isolation and quantification from a minimum of 6,000 biological samples, including samples from kwashiorkor/marasmic-kwashiorkor cases and marasmus controls. Project Administrator � 10% Effort The Project Administrator shall support study logistics, procurement activities, staff management, invoices and payments, and other administrative requirements associated with performance of the project. The Government intends to solicit and negotiate with only one source because the required services can be provided by only one responsible source capable of satisfying the Government's requirements. The requirement is highly specialized and is directly dependent upon the Contractor's established research infrastructure, access to the existing biorepository and associated electronic records in Kilifi, Kenya, established relationships with the relevant study population, and specialized scientific expertise concerning severe childhood malnutrition, including kwashiorkor, marasmus, marasmic-kwashiorkor, and Kenyan populations. The proposed Contractor's designated Kenya Principal Investigator (PI) and research team possess specialized subject-matter expertise in kwashiorkor, marasmus, and the relevant Kenyan study population and have access to the existing biological samples, participant records, and associated research infrastructure necessary to execute the required work. The Government requires the Contractor to obtain and process samples from the existing population and associated biorepository records rather than establish a new population, develop new biorepository infrastructure, or independently recreate the historical medical and anthropometric information required for this study. The use of an alternative source would require establishing new participant recruitment and research infrastructure and would not provide the same access to the existing cohort, records, biological materials, historical data, and population-specific expertise necessary to meet the Government's scientific objectives within the required period of performance. Additionally, the Kenya PI's specialized knowledge of the study population is necessary to support interpretation of the research findings and appropriate dissemination of pooled, de-identified results to the affected population in Kenya in accordance with local and cultural expectations. Accordingly, the Government has determined that the proposed source is uniquely positioned to satisfy the requirement and that no other responsible source is expected to satisfy the Government's requirements without substantial duplication of effort, delay, and/or unacceptable impact on the scientific integrity and objectives of the study. Therefore, the Government intends to award this requirement on a sole-source basis pursuant to FAR 6.302-1. This notice is not a request for competitive quotations. However, interested parties that believe they can meet the Government's requirements may submit a capability statement demonstrating their ability to provide the required services and satisfy all specified technical and operational requirements. The Government will consider all timely capability statements received and determine whether the acquisition should proceed as a sole-source procurement or be competed. The Government anticipates making an award approximately five (5) calendar days after the closing date of this notice, unless the Government determines that another responsible source is capable of meeting the requirement. Capability statements shall be submitted electronically to haunp@mail.nih.gov no later than 9:00 a.m. EDT on September 18, 2026. Please reference Notice No. 75N98026Q01186 in the subject line of the response.

GOVERNMENT REQUIREMENTS: The purpose of this project is to construct a full width ramp with a series of 31 weirs and pools. These weirs are designed as an upstream-pointing arch with side slopes which concentrate the flow towards the center of the channel. Further design elements include a 4-foot-wide V-notch in the weir and 1.5-foot diameter boulders emplaced on the weir. The 31st weir (upstream most weir) will be constructed entirely of concrete the intent is to protect the less robust rock emplacements by breaking up incoming ice. Construction of the fishway will involve partial demolition and excavation of the spillway and underlying bedrock to anchor the fishway to the rock and replace the existing spillway. On the downstream end of the fishway the existing channel will be removed for a length of 150 feet. A four foot-wide embedded low-flow channel in the center of the fishway has been designed to provide sufficient depth of water and flow during normal low flow conditions to allow fish passage. A series of parallel transverse rock ridges that consist of 1�6� foot diameter stones will be evenly spaced along the length of the ramp to provide a series of pools and falls. This low-flow channel and rock ridges are designed to allow for the passage of fish and other aquatic life would occur. In addition to construction of the fishway, this requirement also includes the construction of a retaining wall. Construction of the retaining wall will require the contractor to investigate site conditions, confirm bedrock depth and quality, and prepare the necessary design revisions. DESCRIPTION OF REQUIREMENT The NIH requires a specialized multi-material additive manufacturing system capable of producing highly realistic anatomical models for research, scientific investigation, medical modeling, training, device development, and related activities. The required system is the Stratasys J850 Digital Anatomy� 3D Printer, a multi-material PolyJet additive manufacturing platform specifically designed for the production of realistic anatomical models. The system is capable of producing complex anatomical structures incorporating varying visual, physical, and biomechanical characteristics intended to simulate selected properties of human tissue and bone. The proposed acquisition includes the J850 Digital Anatomy Printer and associated Stratasys equipment, proprietary software, materials, accessories, and manufacturer-supported services necessary for operation of the system. The J850 Digital Anatomy platform utilizes specialized Digital Anatomy materials, including TissueMatrix�, BoneMatrix�, GelMatrix�, and RadioMatrix�, which are designed for applications requiring different physical, mechanical, visual, and radiological characteristics. The system also incorporates Stratasys Digital Anatomy software and anatomical presets that provide established combinations of materials and printing parameters for the production of complex anatomical models. These capabilities are integral to the Government's intended research applications and reduce the need to independently develop, characterize, and validate alternative materials and printing methodologies. The required system must provide an integrated combination of hardware, proprietary materials, software, validated printing parameters, anatomical presets, and manufacturer technical support. The Government's requirement is not limited to the acquisition of a general-purpose 3D printer; rather, it requires a commercially established platform capable of producing realistic anatomical models with the physical and biomechanical characteristics necessary for the intended NIH research applications. The J850 Digital Anatomy Printer and associated proprietary Digital Anatomy ecosystem provide capabilities that are not readily available as an integrated solution from alternative manufacturers. Substitution with a different additive manufacturing platform would require the Government to develop and validate alternative materials, printing parameters, anatomical models, and associated workflows. Such efforts would result in additional cost, schedule delays, technical risk, and uncertainty regarding whether the resulting models would satisfy the Government's research requirements. Acquisition of the J850 will allow NIH researchers to utilize an established commercial platform with compatible proprietary materials, software, anatomical presets, technical documentation, manufacturer training, warranty support, maintenance, and technical assistance. Failure to obtain the required system would prevent or substantially delay planned NIH research activities requiring highly realistic, multi-material anatomical models. description: The U.S. Department of Health and Human Services (HHS), Office of Mission Acquisition Solutions (OMAS), on behalf of the Administration for Children and Families (ACF), Office of Refugee Resettlement (ORR), Division of Technology (DoT), intends to solicit and negotiate on a sole-source basis with: Coforma LLC,1200 18th Street NW, Suite 700, Washington, DC 20036-2531; for the continued operation, maintenance, enhancement, and Tier 3 end-user support of the ORR Process and Technology Modernization (OPTM) Platform and Home Studies/Post-Release Services (HS/PRS) applications, including associated shared OPTM platform infrastructure supporting the ORRbit application ecosystem. This notice is being publicized in accordance with RFO FAR 5.101, Presolicitation Notice. The Government intends to award the proposed bridge contract to Coforma LLC pursuant to RFO FAR 6.103-1, Only One Responsible Source and No Other Supplies or Services Will Satisfy Agency Requirements, subject to approval of the required justification for other than full and open competition. The contemplated sole-source action is limited to the interim bridge requirement and is intended to maintain continuity of existing production services while the Government completes a competitive follow-on acquisition. Procurement History This is not a new requirement. The OPTM requirement has been performed by Coforma LLC since September 2023 under awards through the Small Business Administration's (SBA) 8(a) Business Development Program. Coforma performed under Contract No. 75ACF123P00017 from September 30, 2023, through September 29, 2024; Contract No. 75ACF124P00015 from September 30, 2024, through September 29, 2025; and currently performs under Contract No. 75P00125C00022, which expires September 29, 2026. These awards were made pursuant to Section 8(a) of the Small Business Act, 15 U.S.C. � 637(a). Description of Requirement The proposed bridge contract will provide continued support for the ORR OPTM Platform and HS/PRS applications. The HS/PRS applications are production systems used by ORR personnel and Provider grantees to support time-sensitive case-management activities for unaccompanied alien children. The OPTM platform also provides shared services and infrastructure used by multiple integrated product teams across the ORRbit ecosystem. The requirement includes continued: Operation, maintenance, and enhancement of the HS/PRS applications; Tier 3 end-user support; Operation, maintenance, and enhancement of shared OPTM platform infrastructure; Support for APIs, microservices, and system integrations; Monitoring, logging, alerting, incident response, and vulnerability remediation; Data collection, analysis, and reporting; and Delivery of prioritized application and platform enhancements. The bridge contract is intended to maintain continuity of these production services while the Government completes the competitive follow-on acquisition and transitions performance to the successor contractor. The draft Performance Work Statement (PWS) is attached to this notice and describes the Government's complete requirements. Interested parties are responsible for reviewing the PWS in its entirety. Basis for Intended Sole-Source Award The Government intends to award the interim bridge requirement to Coforma LLC, the incumbent contractor, pursuant to RFO FAR 6.103-1, Only One Responsible Source and No Other Supplies or Services Will Satisfy Agency Requirements. Coforma currently operates and supports the production HS/PRS applications and shared OPTM platform infrastructure and possesses the personnel, system access, credentials, and technical and operational knowledge necessary to continue performance without interruption. Award to another source for the limited bridge period would require transition of the existing production environment, including personnel onboarding and credentialing, system and repository access, and transfer of technical and operational knowledge. The Government would then be required to conduct a second transition to the contractor selected through the planned competitive follow-on acquisition. These successive transitions would result in substantial duplication of transition costs and effort and unacceptable delay while increasing the risk of disruption to ongoing production operations. Accordingly, the Government intends to award the bridge requirement to Coforma LLC to maintain continuity while the competitive follow-on acquisition is completed. This determination is limited to the interim bridge requirement and does not reflect a determination that other sources are incapable of performing the long-term OPTM requirement. Planned Competitive Follow-On Acquisition The Government intends to conduct a competitive follow-on acquisition for the long-term OPTM requirement. The contemplated sole-source action is limited to the interim bridge period necessary to maintain continuity of existing production services while the Government completes the competitive acquisition and transitions performance to the successful offeror. During the bridge period, the Government intends to continue acquisition planning and appropriate industry engagement in support of the competitive follow-on. Information concerning the follow-on acquisition will be publicized separately in accordance with applicable RFO FAR requirements. Interested parties are encouraged to monitor SAM.gov for future notices and solicitation information concerning the long-term OPTM requirement. The contemplated bridge award to Coforma LLC does not provide Coforma any preference or entitlement with respect to the planned competitive follow-on acquisition. Responses to This Notice This Notice of Intent is not a request for competitive proposals or quotations and does not constitute a solicitation. However, all responsible sources may submit a capability statement or other written response demonstrating their ability to satisfy the Government's requirement. Timely responses will be considered by the Government in determining whether another responsible source can satisfy the requirement and whether a competitive procurement is appropriate. Interested parties shall review the attached PWS and provide specific and verifiable information demonstrating their ability to perform the full scope of the requirement and achieve operational readiness by September 30, 2026, without disruption to ongoing production operations. Relevant Experience and Technical Capability: Provide specific examples of recent experience performing comparable Federal IT services involving production application and platform operations and maintenance, Agile development, Federal cloud environments, APIs and microservices, DevSecOps/CI/CD, Tier 3 end-user support, system integrations, and applicable Federal information-security requirements. 3. Staffing and Resources: Describe the respondent's ability to provide sufficient qualified personnel and identify any subcontractors, teaming partners, or other resources necessary to perform the full requirement. 4. Transition and Operational Readiness: Provide a specific approach and schedule for assuming responsibility for the existing production environment and achieving operational readiness by September 30, 2026, without disruption to ongoing operations. The response should address, as applicable, personnel onboarding and credentialing, PIV requirements, Government-furnished equipment, system and repository access, technical and operational knowledge transfer, continuity of production services, and significant Government dependencies. 5. title: Laser Capture Microdissection Microscope System
description: FAR 6.302-1 � Only One Responsible Source Solicitation Number 75N98026Q01125 Title Accuva Cellect Laser Capture Microdissection (LCM) System Description of Requirement The National Institutes of Health intends to award a contract to Laxco, Inc. on a sole-source basis pursuant to FAR 6.302-1, Only One Responsible Source and No Other Supplies or Services Will Satisfy Agency Requirements, for the acquisition of an Accuva Cellect Laser Capture Microdissection (LCM) system, including associated software, equipment, installation, training, and support, as applicable. The Accuva Cellect LCM is required to support the Government's established laser capture microdissection research activities. The system must provide specialized capabilities for performing complex laser capture microdissections involving large numbers of regions of interest (ROIs), extensive freehand markup and editing, and selective capture and cutting of individually identified objects or groups. The Accuva Cellect LCM was developed as the successor to the Arcturus XT LCM system, which was discontinued in 2024. The Accuva Cellect retains the software environment and workflow characteristics necessary to support the Government's established LCM procedures. Specific Technical Requirements The required LCM system must provide the following capabilities: Large-Scale ROI Management: The ability to create, manipulate, retain, and process a large number of regions of interest during complex laser capture microdissection procedures without significant loss of system performance. Advanced Freehand Markup Editing: The ability to continuously edit freehand markings, including partial erasure of an existing markup and smooth continuation of the same markup. Selective Object and Group Capture: The ability to individually select objects or groups of objects for capture and/or cutting while retaining a large number of other existing markups. Retention of Complex Markups: The ability to maintain extensive numbers of ROIs and markups while performing additional selections, edits, captures, and cuts within the same workflow. System Stability During Complex Workflows: The ability to perform the foregoing operations without repeated freezing or other interruptions that require the user to reconstruct or substantially modify the LCM workflow. Established Workflow Compatibility: The ability to support the Government's existing research protocols and workflows based on the software and functionality associated with the Arcturus XT LCM platform. Pursuant to FAR 6.302-1, the Government intends to solicit and award a Purchase Order on a sole-source basis because the Government's minimum technical requirements can only be satisfied by the Accuva Cellect LCM system manufactured and supplied by Laxco, Inc. The Government's requirement is based upon specific functional capabilities necessary to perform complex laser capture microdissection procedures. These capabilities are not simply general LCM functions; they involve the ability to efficiently manage large numbers of ROIs and markups, continuously edit freehand markings, selectively capture or cut individually identified objects or groups, and retain extensive markup information throughout the procedure. Based on the Government's market research and knowledge of available LCM systems, Laxco, Inc. is the only known responsible source capable of providing a system that satisfies all of the Government's stated technical requirements. Accordingly, the Government intends to award a sole-source contract to Laxco, Inc. pursuant to FAR 6.302-1. This notice is not a request for competitive quotations. However, interested parties that believe they can meet the Government's requirements may submit a capability statement demonstrating their ability to provide the required supplies and meet all specified technical and operational requirements. The Government will consider all timely capability statements received and determine whether the acquisition should proceed as a sole-source procurement or be competed. The Government anticipates making an award approximately five (5) calendar days after the closing date of this notice, unless the Government determines that another responsible source is capable of meeting the requirement. Capability statements shall be submitted electronically to davisroshonna@mail.nih.gov no later than 9:00 a.m. EDT on September 21, 2026. Please reference Notice No. 75N98026Q01125 in the subject line of the response.

description: This is a combined synopsis/solicitation and request for proposals (RFP) for commercial products or commercial services in accordance with the procedures of Federal Acquisition Regulation (FAR) part 12 - Acquisition of Commercial Products and Commercial Services and FAR part 15 - Contracting by Negotiation. Specifically, the Federal Housing Finance Agency (FHFA) is issuing this RFP in accordance with Attachment A, Performance Work Statement (PWS), Section 25, �On-Ramping and Refresh of [Indefinite-Delivery, Indefinite-Quantity] IDIQ Holders,� which states, �the Government retains the unilateral right, at any time during the ordering period of this IDIQ contract, to issue additional solicitations and award new IDIQ contracts for the same or substantially similar scope of work to refresh, expand, or otherwise ensure an adequate pool of qualified contractors.� FHFA issued previous RFP FHF-26-R-0032 for �Legal and Strategic Advisory Services,� which resulted in award of six (6) multiple-award IDIQ contracts: 95314326D0002 (ARNOLD & PORTER KAYE SCHOLER LLP) 95314326D0003 (BAKER & HOSTETLER LLP) 95314326D0004 (COHEN SEGLIAS PALLAS GREENHALL & FURMAN PC) 95314326D0005 (DUANE MORRIS LLP) 95314326D0006 (MAYNARD NEXSEN P.C) 95314326D0007 (MINTZ, LEVIN, COHN, FERRIS, GLOVSKY AND POPEO, P.C.) As a result of this Refresh / On-Ramping RFP, FHFA anticipates awarding multiple (likely no more than three (3)) IDIQ contract(s) with an ordering period from effective date of award to 07/26/2031, with the ability for task order performance to extend beyond that date in accordance with applicable terms and procedures. FHFA reserves the unilateral right to award no new IDIQ contracts under this Refresh / On-Ramping RFP. In the event FHFA awards IDIQ contracts as a result of this Refresh / On-Ramping RFP, the IDIQ contracts awarded will be incorporated into the existing multiple-award IDIQ contract vehicle and be eligible to compete for task orders as of the effective date of the award. This announcement constitutes the only solicitation with offers requested. FHFA has a requirement for law firms to provide legal and strategic advisory services to FHFA, which may include but are not limited to: litigation at the state and federal level; oversight and coordination of legal strategy; advice on policy decision making; regulatory advice with respect to the Regulated Entities, the Office of Finance, and U.S. FinTech LLC; significant experience with the Housing and Economic Recovery Act of 2008; legal advice in the areas of banking law, securities law, financial services regulation law; significant experience with the requirements of the Dodd-Frank Wall Street Reform and Consumer Protection Act, bankruptcy law, real estate law, antitrust law, administrative law, corporate law (including matters involving boards of directors and governance), insurance law, conservatorships and receiverships of financial institutions, insolvency law, artificial intelligence, privacy law (including but not limited to Privacy Act and Freedom of Information Act matters), internal operations, and other areas of law as needed. A significant portion of the work under these contracts is anticipated to be litigation related, both at the trial court and appellate levels. Litigation services may include, but are not limited to, investigations relating to fraud or other matters; multifamily and single-family real estate matters such as foreclosures, receiverships, or lien priority; federal, state, and local actions that may involve fines, fees, or penalties; issues that may arise related to the conservatorships of Fannie Mae or Freddie Mac; and other litigation or legal advice concerning matters related to the Regulated Entities, the Office of Finance, and U.S. FinTech, LLC. For litigation services, the Contractor shall also provide, as directed by FHFA, court reporting, videography, electronic discovery, exhibit preparation, and expert consultants/witnesses, and any other litigation related services as needed, including administrative and operational support services to support the representation of FHFA. In addition to litigation related issues, contractors are sought for non-litigation areas of legal practice to provide legal advice, analysis, and fact-finding, if appropriate, that are related to the areas of expertise described above. Challenge sponsor: Department of National Defense (DND) Funding mechanism: Contract Opening date: August 24, 2026 Closing date: September 21, 2026, 14:00 Eastern time Challenge Problem statement The CA soldier will face an increasingly complex and dangerous battlespace in the future. A major element of the complexity and danger is the proliferation of multi-spectral sensors and precision weapons that will limit the CA’s ability to move cargo and strike enemy targets at range by using attritable ballistic trajectory weapons without the risk of being targeted and attacked. The CA presently lacks an UGS capable of conducting short-range cargo delivery of light supplies or remote munitions drops. The CA requires an innovative cargo UGS that provides an uncrewed alternative to move combat supplies forward towards the frontline and to deliver munitions independent of predictable ballistic trajectories and large visual signatures. This innovation must be simple, durable, and highly survivable, providing soldiers with an effective capability for future conflicts that integrates seamlessly into operations while minimizing training and maintenance requirements, allowing soldiers to focus on their mission. Have a maximum weigh of 410kg in an unladen state. 4. Have a minimum operational radius of 5km (unladen) from the GCS while maintaining user control and live video via Radio Frequency link. 5. Have a minimum operational radius of 10km (unladen) while operating autonomously. 6. Operate at a minimum speed of 15km/hr and a minimum endurance of 4hrs in continuous motion while in an unladen state. 7. Be able to tow a load of 275kg. 8. Be able to carry a load of 140kg onboard the ground vehicle. 9. Be able to carry a tri-wall cargo container measuring 122cm (length) x 102cm (width) x 92cm (height) onboard the ground vehicle. 10. Be capable of navigating paved roads, sand trails, and gravel trails during both day and night at a minimum gradient of 15 degrees (approach and lateral). 11. Have sustained mobility of =7 km/h across while carrying its rated payload across roads, trails, and cross-country terrain. The vehicle must ascend 20% grades, traverse 15% side slopes, negotiate a 250 mm vertical step, and cross a 500 m trench. Additional outcomes The proposed solution should: 1. Be deployable from a stowed state to a mission-ready state in 30 minutes or less. This includes the completion of all pre-mission preparation activities, including but not limited to unstrapping/unloading vehicle, loading/fueling the power system and loading/configuring mission set, resulting in a vehicle that is fully mission-ready at the line of departure. 2. Be appropriately sized such that a minimum of two UGS are stowable for transport on a standard palletized loading system (PLS) deck of 2.44 m x 6.10 m (8 feet wide by 20 feet long). 3. Be capable of operating via fibre-optic cable or other non-electromagnetic (non-EM) communications, enabling operator control from at least 100 m from the vehicle. 4. be powered by electric or hybrid engines; 5. incorporate front automated obstacle avoidance features; 6. emit no more than 5 decibels Sound Pressure Level (dB SPL) of noise in all frequency ranges, measured at a 500m distance from the vehicle; 7. Be recoverable by a North Atlantic Treaty Organization (NATO)-standard tow hook. 8. Have an aggregated projected production cost of $150,000 CAD or less per system. 9. Have a Ground Control Station (GCS) that: a. Incorporates a simulation capability for Mission Planning. b. Has a minimum remote antenna cable length of 50m. c. Enables UGS navigation via both direct operator control and autonomously using waypoint navigation via the Global Navigation Satellite System (GNSS). d. Is capable of interfacing with the Tactical Assault Kit (TAK) battle management system to push uncrewed aircraft system (UAS) Position Location Information (PLI) and target PLI. f. title: Spectrum Auction Verification Services for the mmWave Auction
description: Innovation, Science and Economic Development Canada (ISED) is seeking an independent contractor to verify that the Power Auctions software correctly implements the final auction rules in accordance with the Policy and Licensing Framework for Spectrum in the 26 GHz and 38 GHz Bands for determining winning bidders and the prices they will pay. description: Please note that late submissions will not be considered or accepted. title: Phase 1 EZ899-270733 Sally Port Gates Drive Actuator Replacement
description: The work includes, but is not limited to, the replacement of the actuators and associated components for the principal entrance sally port exterior and interior gates, including the removal of existing equipment and the installation of new actuators, rails, mounting assemblies, magnetic locks, control components, conduits, wiring, and operating controls. Associated work includes electrical and mechanical work, metal fabrication and welding, asphalt and concrete cutting and demolition, trenching while maintaining vehicle access, asphalt and concrete restoration, system integration, testing, commissioning, and training required for a complete and operational sally port gate system.
